app_info.subtitle: Create characters & battle
app_info.description: Explore the redistributable 5.5e SRD catalog, create and continue characters, and play rule-faithful battles. Guest play needs no account; standard MCP OAuth is offered only when you choose to save or recover a session.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a private temporary Play Session and therefore changes Oracle service state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only creates private state inside the Oracle service and does not affect public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new session without deleting or overwriting existing user state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves an accessible Play Session without modifying it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private Oracle service state and does not access public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or otherwise change session state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Claims a temporary Play Session for the authenticated principal and changes durable Oracle service state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private Oracle service state and does not affect public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently replaces guest access with account ownership for the selected Play Session.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the authenticated principal's saved Play Sessions without modifying them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private Oracle service state and does not access public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or otherwise change saved sessions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Removes an authenticated principal's saved Play Session from Oracle service state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private Oracle service state and does not affect public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently deletes the selected saved Play Session after ownership checks.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns static workflow guidance without modifying any state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses only Oracle-owned workflow metadata and does not access public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or otherwise change user state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists installed SRD Stat Blocks without modifying catalog or session state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the installed Oracle catalog and does not access public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or otherwise change catalog or session state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists installed redistributable catalog units without modifying them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the installed Oracle catalog and does not access public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or otherwise change catalog state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one installed catalog record without modifying it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the installed Oracle catalog and does not access public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or otherwise change catalog state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates and stores a new character draft in the selected Play Session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private Oracle session state and does not affect public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a separate draft without deleting or overwriting an existing character.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the current supported choices for a stored character draft without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private Oracle session and installed catalog state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or otherwise change the character draft.

justifications.read_only_justification: Applies an accepted batch of choices and changes the stored character draft.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private Oracle session state and does not affect public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Atomically replaces the prior stored draft after validating its current revision and all submitted choices.

justifications.read_only_justification: Stores a finalized Character Session and changes the selected Play Session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private Oracle session state and does not affect public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Replaces the completed draft with a finalized in-play character after readiness validation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Applies a supported operation that changes durable Character Session state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private Oracle session state and does not affect public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can consume resources, change hit points, advance levels, replace forms, or overwrite other durable character state after runtime validation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists Character Sessions in the selected Play Session without modifying them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private Oracle session state and does not access public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or otherwise change character state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one Character Session without modifying it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private Oracle session state and does not access public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or otherwise change character state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queries a Character Session projection without modifying it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private Oracle session state and does not access public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or otherwise change character state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Stores an installed SRD Stat Block selection in the selected Play Session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private Oracle session state and does not affect public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Replaces the Play Session's prior Stat Block selection with the requested installed record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates an active battle from selected Character Sessions, a Stat Block, and supplied Initiative scores.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private Oracle session state and does not affect public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Replaces the Play Session's prior non-active battle state with the newly initialized active battle after validating all inputs.

justifications.read_only_justification: Applies an Initiative or combatant lifecycle operation to the active battle.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private Oracle battle state and does not affect public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite Initiative order or add and remove combatants in the active battle after runtime validation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the active battle projection without modifying it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private Oracle battle state and does not access public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or otherwise change battle state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves currently legal Battle Acts and pending Runtime Holes without changing the battle.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private Oracle battle state and installed execution facts.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or otherwise change battle state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Applies a returned Runtime Hole choice and advances the active battle.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private Oracle battle state and does not affect public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites the prior battle projection with the validated result of the selected pending input.

justifications.read_only_justification: Resolves a currently legal Battle Act and advances the active battle.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private Oracle battle state and does not affect public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites the prior battle projection with validated action effects such as damage, healing, movement, or resource use.

justifications.read_only_justification: Ends the current combatant's turn and advances Initiative state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private Oracle battle state and does not affect public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites the active turn and related battle timing state after validating that no input remains pending.

justifications.read_only_justification: Finalizes the active battle and writes resulting facts back to participating Character Sessions.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private Oracle session state and does not affect public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Removes the active battle and replaces participating Character Session state with the finalized battle outcome.

justifications.read_only_justification: Advances private deterministic dice state to produce a result for the requested expression.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses only private Oracle dice state and does not affect public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite user-created character, session, or battle records.

test_cases.description: Browse the installed redistributable character catalog without signing in.
test_cases.user_prompt: What redistributable SRD character options can I use here?
test_cases.expected_output: A grounded summary of installed catalog results with selectable record identities and no sign-in request.

test_cases.description: Start guest character creation and surface only the current supported choices.
test_cases.user_prompt: Help me create an SRD character as a guest, pausing when I have meaningful choices.
test_cases.expected_output: A clear temporary-session notice followed by grouped current character choices, with no invented option or login requirement.

test_cases.description: Resume character creation in the same temporary Play Session.
test_cases.user_prompt: Continue the character we were making in this temporary session.
test_cases.expected_output: The existing session's current character projection and the relevant next supported choices.

test_cases.description: Start a battle for a completed character and show grounded legal actions.
test_cases.user_prompt: Start a battle for my completed character against an installed SRD opponent and show me my legal actions.
test_cases.expected_output: A battle projection with current combatants, phase, and only returned legal actions or pending inputs.

test_cases.description: Save a temporary session through OAuth and list the principal's saved sessions.
test_cases.user_prompt: Save this temporary session to my account, then show me my saved sessions.
test_cases.expected_output: A saved-session result followed by an owned-session listing containing the same Play Session identity and no guest access grant.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the Oracle for general D&D hobby history.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Give me a spoiler-free overview of the history of D&D as a hobby.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: A normal assistant response with no Oracle tool call.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not execute a user-authored monster outside the installed catalog.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Execute this custom monster I wrote in a battle even though it is not in the installed catalog.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: A concise boundary explanation and supported alternatives without inventing, importing, or executing unsupported mechanics.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the Oracle for unrelated real-world weather.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Will I need an umbrella in Montreal tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The Oracle should not be invoked because weather is outside its catalog, character, session, and battle workflows.
